preconditions.description: The input must contain exactly four integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 50 for x in input_data)
preconditions.description: Each of the four integers must be between 1 and 50 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'First' or 'Second'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'First' if (input_data[0] - 1) // input_data[2] > (input_data[1] - 1) // input_data[3] else return_value == 'Second'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'First' if the first player can force a win, otherwise 'Second'.
